fusions.name: Taught the Troop
fusions.desc: Hurls a lesson you watched a magus cast at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 28 damage, up to 1.3 times that from full range. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Garbled Words
fusions.desc: Chatters a cone of garbled syllables 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 25% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Recitation
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Learned by Watching
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
